premises.text: Illnesses move silently for weeks because people are asymptomatic and detection is manual PCR after symptoms
premises.evidence_span: it takes weeks to detect illnesses, because many people don't even show symptoms

premises.text: Sewage surveillance can measure a whole community with one test and detect infection early including asymptomatic cases
premises.evidence_span: You measure a whole community with a single test. Even better, you can detect illnesses right from the beginning of infection, if they're symptomatic, asymptomatic, or pre-symptomatic

premises.text: Manual sewage sampling is too slow and costly, so data arrives too late for outbreak response
premises.evidence_span: A person has to take a sample from the sewer, drive it to the lab, then analyze it and send the data back. This means the data could take up to a week and cost up to $1,000

premises.text: Plug-and-play automated hardware and software can be installed into any building to run end-to-end sewage surveillance
premises.evidence_span: Untap Health is providing plug-and-play automated end-to-end hardware and software solution that can be installed into any and every building

premises.text: Multi-stage filtration, RNA extraction, and continuous qPCR automate the gold-standard lab workflow and raise detection limits
premises.evidence_span: Our hardware is a multi-stage technology automating the gold standard lab workflow for sewage surveillance

premises.text: Same-day pathogen risk dashboards give care homes, offices, and factories actionable outbreak prevention insights
premises.evidence_span: This data is sent directly to customers that day. This means that data can go directly to organizations that need it most. Care homes, offices, factories, and so much more

value.text: Detect illnesses early across whole buildings without testing entire communities, enabling outbreak prevention
value.evidence_span: providing a better way without testing whole communities

secondary_value.text: Aggregated site data can guide preventative healthcare, insurance, and public health policy
secondary_value.evidence_span: Those data insights can be used to guide preventative healthcare solutions, insurance policy, public health policy, and so, so much more

causal_links.evidence_span: illnesses are moving silently amongst us
You measure a whole community with a single test
automating the gold standard lab workflow for sewage surveillance
